title: [DHS SRE POST-MORTEM] Cascading Outage Root-Caused to chi-argus-clickhouse (ClickHouseConnectionPoolExhausted)
executive_summary: On 2026-10-17 at 20:13:13 UTC, a major cascading degradation was detected across 4 microservices in the Argus environment. The Argus Topological AIOps Engine successfully grouped 4 alert notifications into a single correlated incident, preventing on-call alert fatigue and isolating chi-argus-clickhouse as the foundational root cause with 99.0% confidence.
root_cause_analysis: Root Cause Analysis indicates the cascade originated at chi-argus-clickhouse due to 'ClickHouseConnectionPoolExhausted'. This failure exhausted upstream connection capacity and induced downstream query latency. Topological graph traversal verified that chi-argus-clickhouse occupies depth 0 in the failure subgraph, confirming it is the upstream origin rather than a downstream symptom.
recommended_remediation: 1. Immediate: Inspect chi-argus-clickhouse connection pool saturation and scale database connection limit.
2. Restart or recycle hung worker connections on dependent services (argus-sample-service, argus-auto-service, argus-synthetic-probe).
3. Verify downstream synthetic canary probes return HTTP 200 OK after database recovery.
4. Long-term: Implement circuit breaker pattern between calling services and chi-argus-clickhouse to prevent cascading thread pool exhaustion.
